title: Transcript of a repeated tester component
statement: Let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester, let $f$ be a function from its query domain to its codomain, and let $k$ be a natural number. For any seed tuple $(s_0,\ldots,s_{k-1})$ and any component $i<k$, the repeated tester's transcript at the query positions belonging to component $i$ is exactly the transcript produced by $T$ on $f$ with seed $s_i$.
hypotheses_covered: A nonadaptive function tester T with finite seed space
A function f from the query domain to the codomain
A tuple of k seeds for T
A component index i with 0 ≤ i < k
